peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.2% below its local comparables; 54 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (58.8): 3.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 154 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 54.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,710,000 ($1,766 psf, 893–1,065 sq ft; 7 resales, Dec 2023–Nov 2025); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,770 psf (range $1,573–2,323); 0.2% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $4,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Apr 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 6 earlier resales do not start the wave.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Siglap MRT about 530 m, Bayshore MRT about 670 m; closer than 248 of 462 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Bedok Green Primary School about 1,120 m; more than 0 of 462 similar developments (the same as 58). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 340 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Bedok South Road Blk 16 about 740 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area E about 590 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Vela Bay, 386 new sales, about 800 m; Sceneca Residence, 3 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 78 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 389 new sales and 550 resales (939 purchases); new sales were 41.4% of these purchases. Subsales (23) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bedok Rise GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,910 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 550 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 133 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 550 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 574 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.2%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
